profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at SLB (formerly Schlumberger)

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Leads a team of 25 developers (including offshore contractors) providing new software solutions and enhancements for existing internal and public facing applications.
•	Extensive Web API development and web services for third party consumption
•	Extensive use of Angular4+, JavaScript, TypeScript (other JS libraries, with Bootstrap framework etc.)
•	Supports entire software development process for requirement definition, design, coding, and testing.
•	New development utilizing .NET, MVC framework.
•	Develops end to end solutions using key technologies on the Microsoft tech stack using SQL database, web-based development (.NET MVC, JavaScript and jQuery
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · JavaScript · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · API Development · REST APIs · Angular

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Work with a team of software developers providing new software solutions and enhancements for an existing Aircraft Maintenance system and any of NASA/JSC’s Aircraft Operations Divisions (AOD) software applications.
•	Develop software under established software engineering standards as part of team.
•	Support entire software development process for requirement definition, design, coding, and testing.
•	New development utilizing .NET, MVC framework.
•	Develops web-based applications using SQL database, web-based development (.NET MVC, JavaScript, and jQuery (other JavaScript libraries, with Bootstrap framework and more)
•	Develop Web APIs and web services for third party consumption. 
•	Extensive use of Visual Studio to develop and maintain applications/projects.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · C# · ASP.NET Web API · Angular

positions.title: Sr. Applications Developer
positions.description:
•	Support 30 plus applications as well as develop new applications according to business requirements.
•	Develops web and desktop applications using SQL database, web-based development (.NET MVC, JavaScript, and jQuery (other JavaScript libraries, with Bootstrap framework and more)
•	Develop Web APIs and web services for third party consumption. 
•	Robotics Process Automation (development): Utilized UiPath to automate business processes.
•	Worked with Azure for building, testing, deploying, and managing applications.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · Microsoft Azure
